name: Basin Bridge Gas Turbine Power Station (BBGTPS)
notes: 4 x 30 MW open-cycle GTs (Feb-Mar 1996). GEO: primary fuel naphtha, secondary light fuel oil/diesel. TNPGCL: "Due to higher fuel costs, the units are planned to be operated ... only during emergencies using High Speed Diesel (HSD)"; black-start unit for Chennai. CEA gas report does not list it (liquid fuel). DGR 2026-27 YTD generation 0 MU. HSD supply chain (refinery/depot, road tanker) not documented. A 2 x 730 MW LNG CCPP at the site was proposed ~2019 and is shown as cancelled by GEM.
